# thousandeyes_endpoint_tests_http_server (Resource)

Retrieves HTTP server endpoint scheduled test.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `agent_selector_type` (String) Specifies how agents are selected for the endpoint test. Agents can be selected from: - all available agents - a specific list of agents - agents matching tags - agents matching labels (deprecated) Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `agents` (Set of String) List of endpoint agent IDs (obtained from `/endpoint/agents` endpoint). Required when `agentSelectorType` is set to `specific-agent`. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `auth_type` (String) HTTP authentication type. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `endpoint_agent_labels` (Set of String, Deprecated) Deprecated. Use `tagIds` instead. List of endpoint agent label IDs (obtained from `/endpoint/labels` endpoint), required when `agentSelectorType` is set to `agent-labels`. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `has_path_trace_in_session` (Boolean) Enables "in session" path trace. When enabled, this option initiates a TCP session with the target server and sends path trace packets within the established TCP session. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `has_ping` (Boolean, Deprecated) Optional flag indicating if the test should run ping. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `has_traceroute` (Boolean, Deprecated) Optional flag indicating if the test should run traceroute. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `http_time_limit` (Number) Maximum amount of time in milliseconds the agents wait before a request times out. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `interval` (Number) Interval between test runs in seconds.
- `ip_version` (String) For reading current network test configurations, the IP version of the test. Values include V4_ONLY, V6_ONLY, V6_PREFER, and OS_DEFAULT. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `is_prioritized` (Boolean) Indicates whether the test should be prioritized when the number of tests assigned to an agent exceeds the license limit. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `max_machines` (Number) Maximum number of agents which can execute the test. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `network_measurements` (Boolean) Enable or disable network measurements. Set to true to enable or false to disable network measurements. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `password` (String) Password for Basic/NTLM authentication. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol requested for the test.
- `ssl_version_id` (String) SSL version options: * Use '0' for automatic selection. * Use '3' for SSLv3. * Use '4' for TLS v1.0. * Use '5' for TLS v1.1. * Use '6' for TLS v1.2. * Use '7' for TLS v1.3. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `tag_ids` (Set of String) List of tag IDs (obtained from `/tags` endpoint). Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `target_response_time` (Number) Response time target in milliseconds. Affects the colors of agents and legends on the view page. The value is compared with actual response time in order to determine the color scale (from green to red). Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `tcp_probe_mode` (String) Probe mode returned by network test APIs, only valid when the protocol is set to TCP. Configuration responses return user-selectable values, while result responses may also return resolved driver values.
- `test_name` (String) Name of the test.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `url` (String) The test target URL.
- `username` (String) Username for Basic/NTLM authentication. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.
- `verify_certificate` (Boolean) Flag indicating if a certificate should be verified. Immutable: the update body does not carry this field, so changing it replaces the test.

### Read-Only

- `aid` (String) A unique identifier associated with your account group. You can retrieve your `AccountGroupId` from the `/account-groups` endpoint.
- `created_date` (String) UTC created date (ISO date-time format).
- `follow_redirects` (Boolean) To disable following HTTP/301 or HTTP/302 redirect directives, set this parameter to `false`.
- `http_target_time` (Number) Target time for HTTP server completion, specified in milliseconds.
- `http_version` (Number) HTTP protocol version. Set to '2' to prefer HTTP/2, or '1' to use only HTTP/1.1.
- `id` (String) The test's unique identifier, assigned by the API.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if test is enabled.
- `is_saved_event` (Boolean) Indicates if the test is a saved event. **Note**: **Saved Events** are now called **Private Snapshots** in the user interface. This change does not affect API.
- `labels` (Attributes Set) Labels to which the test is assigned. This field is not returned for Instant Tests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))
- `modified_date` (String) UTC last modification date (ISO date-time format).
- `port` (Number) Port number.
- `server` (String) Target domain name or IP address.
- `ssl_version` (String) Reflects the verbose SSL protocol version used by a test.
- `test_id` (String) Each test is assigned a unique ID to access test data from other endpoints.
- `type` (String) Type of test being queried.
- `use_ntlm` (Boolean) Set to true to use NTLM, false to use Basic Authentication. Requires username and password to be set.
